name: Haruto Akiyama
source:
Haruto Akiyama is the protagonist and viewpoint character of My Funeral Is Sunday. A schoolboy whose everyday routine has come to include Mio Tachibana, he finds himself unexpectedly invited to her funeral, despite her being perfectly healthy and alive.

Haruto is observant, thoughtful, and often responds to Mio's unpredictable behaviour with dry humour. Although he has grown accustomed to her presence, he does not always recognise how much their ordinary interactions mean to him.

As the funeral approaches, Haruto must navigate Mio's unusual plans alongside two other invitees, Yuta Moriyama and Reina Fujimoto. His responses and choices shape how he expresses his feelings and understands his relationship with Mio.
